profile_text.body:
Kyndryl is a public company, traded under the ticker KD, founded in 2021 and headquartered in New York, NY. In its own words, it designs, builds, manages and modernizes the mission-critical technology systems that the world depends on every day.

The company's site frames AI largely around workforce and resilience questions. It points to a 2026 People Readiness Report, which Kyndryl says reveals a decline in workforce readiness as AI adoption surges, and to a separate People Readiness Report that examines why workforce readiness has become one of the most important factors determining AI success. Kyndryl also describes AI-native enterprises as those that put AI at the core of their business to create conditions for continuous growth, efficiency and resilience, and it hosts The Innovation Show x The Kyndryl Institute podcast, where five leaders discuss how AI is evolving current business models. A further theme on the site is security: as geopolitical tensions escalate and AI accelerates attackers' capabilities, Kyndryl says organizations must rethink what resilience looks like in the context of prosperity, security and public trust.

Company records list a CIK of 0001867072 and a litigation record of 458 cases in New York.
